title: Mixed Event — Mirage of Light

meta.Outline: Ever since one of Kanade's songs made Mafuyu smile, Mafuyu has wondered why. As the group searches for the answer together, her health suddenly takes a turn for the worse.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm finally done with homework for today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And it's almost 25:00...
I need to log onto Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No response...
Looks like they're not even logged in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
We're supposed to meet in SEKAI today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade wanted to talk in person about the video and lyrics for our new song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you all look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you have no idea what you just did?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You smiled, Mafuyu! It's because of Kanade's song!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It started off like any other song, but something began welling up inside my chest as I kept listening.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why did that song make me feel that way?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I'm starting to get a headache...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. This SEKAI's quietness had a nice charm to it, but it is nice to have visitors like this from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, am I late to the party?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, you are!
Where were you? Do you know how long you kept us waiting?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I said I'm sorry. I found these really cute materials for our video and sort of lost track of time after I started playing around with them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
She should be here soon.
She said that she just finished doing her homework.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good. Time to hurry up and wait! What should we do in the meantime? How about a word game?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. We're not little kids, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! Don't be like that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, it's okay. We knew that you were busy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what are you actually doing here today...? You mentioned something about having a discussion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Remember that song I composed the other day? I want to find a way to make it so it resonates with more people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I asked everyone to meet here today to talk about what I'd like this song to do before we gave it lyrics and made a video for it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If we're gonna make that happen, I'll have to up my art game!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It was clear to me how much effort you put into that song, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, it was so good!
Like K's reached a whole new level!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not only that, you made Mafuyu smile. Who would've guessed that would happen?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
True...
That honestly left me a little staggered.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I can't wait to see what kind of lyrics you write for this song, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure? You seem more expressionless than usual...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's found the key to the door that she's been searching for, but doesn't know where the keyhole is, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's difficult to explain, but I believe Mafuyu knows what I mean.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I kept running circles in my head thinking about why your song made me smile, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Something welled up inside my chest that time. That's probably what made me smile.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I don't understand why that happened... I just don't know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean why? You felt that way because Kanade's song really touched your heart, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But why was I so touched by it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No other song has made me feel this way so far. Why this song? Why did it feel so warm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-How am I supposed to know...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you want to know why you smiled...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You might not know now, but you might find the answer you're looking for if you give it a little time, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But at the same time, you probably want to know why before you start writing your lyrics, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to find an answer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Look, we get that...
But how exactly do you plan on doing that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, why don't we think about it together...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I too want to learn more about why you felt the way you did, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So let's find an answer together, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh oh, hold up...!
Mafuyu, mind if I feel your forehead?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you're running a fever?!
Are you sure you're okay?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I'm just feeling a little lightheaded...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That hardly counts as being okay.
Ugh, there really aren't any dull moments when it comes to you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's postpone this discussion until after Mafuyu's fever breaks...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please, go home and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's call it an evening, and make sure to get some good sleep in, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't forget to stay warm and hydrated too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'm sure it's just a cold, so I should be all better soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A fever. That explains why my head felt so heavy and foggy this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I still want to know why that song made me smile... As soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (As much as I want to get ready for cram school tomorrow, it really might be best if I just rested today.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Go home, take some medicine and sleep...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Let's see. The medicine should be in the kitchen...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, it's just mom and dad talking...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, hello...
Oh, that's right. Dad didn't have work today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What are you two looking at?
Is that an album...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Look, Mafuyu.
They're pictures of you when you were little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Your mother suggested that we look at them after all this time and we ended up chatting for hours.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Really...?
I feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Honey, look. This was when Mafuyu won a prize for that essay contest she entered in to during the first grade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, I still remember.
And the one next to it is of her as the heroine of a play.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I made this Snow White dress just for you after seeing how dreadfully dull that costume your classmate initially gave you was.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Uh, it's nothing...
I didn't know that. Thank you, mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. It was my pleasure. I mean, you were supposed to be the star of the show. It would've been a shame to see you wear such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And you'll be getting ready for entrance exams next year. How do you feel? Do you think you're ready?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Since you're aiming for medical school, you'll need to be perfect across the board. If things aren't going well at cram school, just tell me and we can find a new one.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And we'll be expecting nothing short of great success.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Seeing those photos...
It's making my chest hurt...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should take this medicine and go to bed right away. Oh, I need to tell everyone that I can't make it today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think I have time to listen to Kanade's song...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Was I dreaming...?
What was that I just saw...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade's song is still on...
I must've fallen asleep while it was playing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My head feels much better after taking that medicine...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But that pain I felt when I saw those photos of me when I was little still bothers me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(My chest definitely hurt...
But it also reminded me of how I feel when I listen to Kanade's song.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mom and dad should be asleep now too, so maybe I can go look through that album.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, it should be in the back of this cupboard...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I was about five when these were taken...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu? What are you doing up?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you decided to look at that album too? Hehe. Did I make you want to reminisce a little more? Nostalgia does have a way of getting the better of us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I suppose so...
I don't remember much from back then, so I wanted to see for myself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, but don't you have to get up early tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Sleep deprivation will take away from your studies. Not only will you not be able to focus during class, your grades may even begin to slip...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, you don't need me to tell you that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I'll head off to bed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good night, mom.
I'll take this up to my room and look at it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I managed to get it up here...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But there are too many distractions here.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to go somewhere that's quiet... Like SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Mafuyu...?
Did you say on Nightcord that you weren't feeling great today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shouldn't you be in bed right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I took some medicine and my fever's gotten much better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki got this new corsage and decided to put it on my skirt for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry, Rin.
The second it caught my eye at the store, I was sure that it'd do with your outfit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But hearing that you caught a cold was a pretty big shock. I mean, if it were Ena instead of you, I wouldn't be surprised considering her lifestyle...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, did you want some alone time? Would it be better if I left...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great!
I never see you here this late, so I'm actually pretty glad that you came, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's nothing, really.
This place lets me get away from everything, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whenever I need some time to think of when something's bothering me, I usually end up here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, whatcha got there?
Looks like a really big book...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom and I were looking at some photos of me when I was little, and it made my chest hurt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I have no idea as to why.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to think clearly at home either, so I came here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... So seeing old pictures of yourself is what did this to you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then how about you show me what you were looking at...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, remember what Kanade said?
We're supposed to help each other out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That album you have there might give us a hint as to why you felt what you did, right? Which is why we should see what you saw.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course it does! You wanna see too, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great!
So how about it, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! Alright, Rin, let's start flipping through this thing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, it's Mafuyu in her archery getup!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That looks so cool!
Oh that's right, you did mention that you were in the archery club.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That was taken during a prefectural tournament where we took second place, I think...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You guys took second?! Look at you, Miss Overachiever!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's nothing special, really.
I was just asked to be a substitute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Asked to sub in...?
No, Mafuyu, you definitely are special.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, it's Mafuyu when she was little! You look adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Your cheeks are all red in this picture too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The girl in this pic seems a lot different from the girl sitting next to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, this little girl looks so happy while eating her birthday cake. Like turning five is the best thing ever.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's different from your good girl persona, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you know what Mizuki's talking about, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No...
I've never thought about that before.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's hard to describe, but it's like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe the Mafuyu back then was able to feel happy in a different way?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Feel happy in a different way...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Does that mean my past self holds the answer to why I feel the way I do when I listen to Kanade's song...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: M-Mafuyu, are you sure you're all right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, just because you took some medicine doesn't mean you're completely cured...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. I think I'm close to finding an answer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you don't have to rush like this. Why not go home and get some rest? We can try this again when you feel better!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know what'll happen if you keep pushing yourself like this, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Good. Now get some sleep.
Come back when you're all better, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really hope she does get better soon...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu's like Kanade. She doesn't know when to stop...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, Mizuki, how did you make that connection when you saw that picture of Mafuyu when she was little...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm pretty good at figuring out what someone's thinking just based on their expression.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Although, I've taken it a little too far in the past, so I try not to do it too much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How do you take that too far?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: People don't always say what they mean because they want to hide something from others, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's easy for me to figure out what's underneath that façade by taking a closer look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've taken that too far before and alienated a lot of people...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been through a lot too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait...
Are you trying to be nice to me, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I have no idea what you're talking about. You just cramp my style when you act all mopey around me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But thanks, Rin.
I'm much better now compared to back then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Some people aren't able to show their real selves to others, while some wander in the dark as they struggle to find their real selves.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope Mafuyu discovers her real self soon...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you're up early. Busy morning I'm guessing?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I have some committee business to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your peers seem to value you very much, but remember that it's perfectly okay to tell a teacher that you don't want to do something. I'd really rather have you focus on your studies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I know...
I'll try asking them about adjusting my workload.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, I need to get going.
Also, I'll probably be home a little late tonight because of cram school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Today's your first day of that new class.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll also be running late tonight due to some neighborhood association business. I'm sorry but you'll have to prepare your own dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, I understand.
Would you like me to make some for you and leave it in the refrigerator for when you get back...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I appreciate the thought, but I suspect that we'll be going to dinner afterwards so that won't be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your father won't be home for some time as well, so please try to make do on your own for tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay. Have a nice day, mom.
I'll be going now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I have even an hour, I should be able to handle everything I need to before our morning assembly...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I didn't have time to yesterday, so after school, I need to read up on what's going to be covered at cram school today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Then I need to provide the teachers a practice schedule for the archery club's first years... Oh, I have a student council meeting and club activities too...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Asahina.
It's so kind of you to help me carry these things after asking you to handle that committee business.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm happy to help... This would be far too much for one person to carry, even a teacher.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Again, thank you. You really are so kind. I sort of don't know what else to say.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure anyone else would do the same.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That took longer than I was hoping...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't have time to study this morning, so that'll have to wait until the latter part of lunch. Maybe during the break too...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line: Mafuyu, this first-year girl who says she's in the archery club is here to see you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, okay. I'll be right there.
Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Junior Club Member
rows.Line: I was taking inventory of all our equipment just now and discovered that we're missing a bow...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: One's missing? That can't be right. Did you make sure to check elsewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Junior Club Member
rows.Line: I did! I even counted several times just to make sure, but I kept falling short by one...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Someone may have taken it home to practice with and simply forgot to bring it back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll check the gym later to see if it's lost in storage somewhere. Would you mind telling the teachers in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Junior Club Member
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Next is... Cram school.
I scrounged up some time during break to read up on today's subject...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I think my headache is starting to get worse...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm running late for cram school...
But this bench... I could rest here for a...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad seemed like he was doing pretty well today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe I'll bring some of his favorite snacks and have them with him next time since the doctor said that we could.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That person lying down on that bench...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, what happened?!
Are you okay...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, that's right.
You caught a cold and...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, can you tell me where you live? We need to let your parents know so that they can come and pick you up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's no way she can give me directions in her current state... And I can't just leave her here...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Here, sling your arm over my shoulder and try to hang on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't have much space other than this, so you'll have to sleep on my bed for now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... What else is she going to need...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let me get you some blankets... Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Something to help cool your head.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What did mom used to do?
She used water... No, ice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I don't even know if there's any ice in the freezer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... Wringing out a wet towel is harder than I expected... My arms are getting tired already...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hopefully, this will do for now.
Just place it over her forehead and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right, food.
I remember Ms. Mochizuki saying that easily digestible foods, such as apples, work best for someone with a cold.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Apples. I should check the supermarket down the street...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I managed to get some...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Mafuyu won't be able to eat these as is in her current state. How do I make it easier for her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's right. Mom used to make apple sauce for me whenever I caught a cold...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But how do I do that...? Do I use a knife...? No, a grater...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mom used to make it look so easy too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You need to rest.
Your fever hasn't broken yet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I tried making some apple sauce for you. Would you like to try some...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good, looks like you can keep it down...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you're still sweating quite a bit. Your towel even feels warm now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Please, just try to rest.
I'll go get you some ice water...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll stay right here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here, hold my hand.
I won't let you be all alone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you poor thing. Just try to take it easy, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hmm... Your fever seems to have gone up too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Would you mind taking off your pajamas, dear? I'd like to get you cleaned up and into some new ones.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I know you're really busy with the neighborhood association and everything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, honey.
You being sick takes priority over all of that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your job is to get as much rest as you can today, so that once you're all better, you'll be able to show us all that beautiful smile of yours.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Our neighbors gave us some apples. You may be sick, but I'm sure they'll still taste just as good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Would you like me to make some apple sauce for you, dear? Or just cut them into slices?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Bunnies...
Make them look like bunnies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You really do love bunnies, don't you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Just one moment, dear.
There we are...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you sit up? You don't have to if you don't think you can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Then why don't we do this...?
Open up for the airplane...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mmm... They're yummy...
Thank you, mommy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Now, mommy needs to go hoist the laundry on the patio, so try to get some sleep, okay, honey?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Can you stay and hold my hand...?
Until I fall asleep...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. My, aren't we full of demands today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, dear. Now, lie down for me, and take my hand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Was that me...? When I was little...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to understand why my chest begins to hurt whenever I look at those photos...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's the same reason why Kanade's song feels so warm...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I felt the same thing back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (When I put that apple slice in my mouth...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. I stopped by the park to rest... And Kanade brought me here to treat me.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, good morning...
How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for taking care of me, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I should be the one apologizing for bringing you here without asking. I wasn't sure what else to do...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, there are still some apples left. Would you like some...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes...
I heard that it's good to eat apples when you catch a cold, so I made some apple sauce for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure if you remember, but you had some earlier. If you think your appetite's back, I can make some more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you, but I'm okay for now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Kanade made apple sauce for me...?
Is that why I saw that dream...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, did you happen to bring any medicine with you? I can get you some water if you need to take it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
They should be in my bag, but they're the type that don't require any water.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, got it.
If you need anything else, please feel free to ask.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure if it's something I need, but I would like to ask you something, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: About that song you composed the other day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What did you feel as you wrote it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought about something that happened a long time ago... When I was with my mom and dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remembered how my dad said that he wanted to make me and my mom smile by playing this song he wrote for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
When we heard it...
We couldn't help but smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to feel what I did. I want you to smile the way I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
My chest...
It feels warm again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Here should be fine.
My house is just right there.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I think I can at least make it that far now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear...
Please, get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Bye, Kanade...
See you on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(My fever's almost gone.
And my headache.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should be all better by tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remembered how my dad said that he wanted to make me and my mom smile by playing this song he wrote for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
When we heard it...
We couldn't help but smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to feel what I did. I want you to smile the way I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I still don't know what it is or what it means...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I should write this down.
I don't want to forget this sensation.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I feel like I need to. For my own sake...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I can't find the right words to describe it. Why...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What was that...? Why did I just think that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's already 4:00...?
Where did all that time go...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, did you manage to get home?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, how you doing?
Enanan won't shut up, so please try to send a reply if you see this! Oh, but you can ignore this if you're still asleep...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yuki! K's worried sick about you!
Say something, will you?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Rin. What are you doing on my computer...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Everyone's waiting for you in SEKAI, but don't really know what to do with themselves right now...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I was getting a little sick of it, so I came here. They'll probably feel better once they know that you're okay.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you worried about me too, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What? No, like I said, I was just sick of seeing the others not knowing what to do...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Honestly, Miku should be one doing this. Not me.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But she kept saying that we should just let you rest and not disturb you if you happened to be in the middle of writing lyrics...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's written all over your face.
I'll go tell the others.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
Kanade wanted me to smile.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Was Rin trying to do the same thing just now?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was actually having a little trouble coming up with the right words for these lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But you helped clear my mind.
I know what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know what I want to write...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm gonna go tell the others.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I still don't know what to call that sensation I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll try to find the right words.
I'll turn that feeling into lyrics for that song...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, much...
Sorry about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's been days since you said you were fine, and now you want us to have a look at your lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry about not saying anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're not getting a second chance, got it...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cut her some slack, girl. She's all better now, so all's well that end's well, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, you finished writing those lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I found the words I was looking for...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The words you were looking for...?
You never say stuff like that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's a nice change of pace.
Mind if we read them over now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line:
I'd like to see them too...
I want to know what you felt when you heard that song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is totally different from what you usually write...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line: Between your usual exclamations, there's thoughtfulness. Like you're trying to console someone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: More than that. It matches Kanade's song perfectly! This might be my new favorite, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
It feels so much deeper than your usual lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade's song reminded me that I'd felt what I did when I heard her song... A long time ago...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Like when I ate apples that time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So... You like apples...? Oh, what if we got together and did an apple-themed dessert party?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I seriously doubt that's what she meant by that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, come on...!
I was joking! Get it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm guessing the past repeated itself somehow and you managed to resurrect that same sensation... Right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know. There's no way for me to verify that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I needed to write it down so I wouldn't forget.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that's great, Mafuyu. It means all that time you invested ended up paying off...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad for you too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mafuyu seems to have reached a new level of understanding regarding herself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so too.
Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line: If you weren't there to help me compose my song, Mafuyu may not have been able to rediscover her feelings and write these lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're exaggerating. All I did was give you a little push.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You did all the work and found your answer. And she took your answer and found her own...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm glad what I did ended up working. Although, pushing too hard can also lead to less than ideal results...

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO.
How long have you been there...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, I sincerely believe that some significant changes need to occur for us to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you still convinced that keeping your distance is best?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not against your idea, but it's also just one of many...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm simply under the impression that I can learn by observing from afar.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We are each within our rights to pursue what we think is best.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Agreeing to disagree, I see? That may also work...

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line: (They're right. There's no right answer when it comes to this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line: (We just need to keep moving forward one step at a time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Good morning, Mafuyu.
Breakfast is ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Our neighbors gave us some apples. It'll be a nice treat to go with your breakfast.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I'll cut some slices for you now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What was that, Mafuyu?
Did you say something just now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, but...
Thank you for making this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And here are your apples, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade.
rows.Line: I'll keep composing...until you can find yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I still don't know what to call what I felt then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think I can keep moving forward. Right, Kanade...?
